regime_context: The detector shows a broad, gold-led precious-metals regime in Canada: Gold Miners and Silver & Royalties hold the top two momentum ranks with trend-positive durability, but crowding flags are extreme (z > 1.6) and the rotation margin over the challenger is modest (0.382) with a broad eligibility fraction (0.81), so leadership is not narrow or one-narrative. Backtest verdicts are honest — momentum rank has no forward return edge, the absolute-trend gate only helps risk control, and this market's track record shows direction accuracy of just 0.278 over 54 prior calls, so conviction should default low and lean toward the trend-gate's downside-protection role rather than any directional edge.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Silver & Royalties (rank 2, durability 0.52) closes the 0.382 rotation margin against Gold Miners with breadth holding above 0.8 — a confirmed handoff to silver leadership, not just a pullback in gold, would be the condition that retires this watch.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners lead momentum and durability with the highest trend gate (0.59, hurst_tag 'trend'), which is the one validated risk-control leg; remaining trend-eligible keeps drawdown control in place. Direction is a humbled lean, not a forecast: momentum rank carries no alpha and crowding_z 1.67 is a size-down caution, not a reason to fade.
evidence: rank 1 with score 1.975 and eligible true
durability_bar 0.59 with hurst_tag 'trend' (trend-gate risk-control leg intact)
theses.dissent: Extreme crowding (z 1.67) plus the documented failure mode of fading the leader cuts both ways — while the trend gate controls tail risk, gold's leadership at this crowding level historically marks late-stage participation, and the low track-record direction accuracy (0.278) says any directional tilt has poor expected value.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO gives up its 10-day leadership and its price moves below its own 50-day trend anchor before the 20-day check-by

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is trend-eligible (true) but sits near the bottom of momentum (rank 10, score -0.485) with a 'mean-revert' hurst_tag and low durability (0.35), meaning the absolute-trend gate is not providing downside protection on the way down; this reads as a weak-leg theme to avoid allocating toward until trend health improves.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert hurst_tag could mean the theme is closer to a bounce than further decline if the defensive/renewables rotation reasserts; avoiding a beaten-down, non-crowded theme may forfeit a snap-back.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO forms a higher low and reclaims a trend-positive durability reading (above 0.5) before the 20-day check-by
